learning_outcomes.text: Participants learn a practical application of production possibilities. They will be able to analyze technically and economically optimal production possibilities and then transfer them into industrial practice.

syllabus_topics: Importance of production technology with regard to optimal production chains, resulting component properties, and alternative production possibilities with conventional and modern materials.
Determination of the optimal production process for practical application with the respective process-specific advantages and disadvantages.
Component production for general and specific applications, for both prototypes and mass production.
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module exam.
